reviews.scope: Full unified just45H+126H matter model explicitly discussed at start ofSectionIVA; completes original scalar-sector extraction using recorded16F baseline.

reviews.reconciliation: Completes the original scalar-sector extraction as the source-defined just45H+126H matter model from SectionIV.A. Only the same-paper ordinary16F baseline is inherited from source field234; no10H or low-energy spectrum is added. Three-family multiplicity is declared SM inheritance, corroborated by the extended model, not a printed minimal-model beta coefficient.
limitations: Definition-scope review, not whole-paper reading or independent physics certification.
Three-family count is declared SM inheritance plus a source beta-function cross-check, not a literal3x16 field table.
The source's criticism of45+126 flavour realism is retained as provenance and is not an intake gate.
The real10 alternative and120H alternative are mentioned in the source but are not included in these two targets.
